free_tier.stated: a monthly pool of 5 vCPU-hours, 20 GiB-hours of memory and 20 GiB-hours of disk with a 1 GiB durable-storage cap, and a hard cap of 3 sandboxes at 1 vCPU, 512 MiB and 8 GiB of disk with no overage

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: not published: the pricing page meters vCPU, memory, disk and durable storage and states no egress allowance or price; public internet access is on by default and can be cut to an allowlist or disabled

interface_detail: CLI (msb), and SDKs for Rust, TypeScript, Python and Go; with an API key the same SDK runs on microsandbox cloud; an MCP server exists

limits.value: 5 vCPU-hours a month on the free pool, hard-capped with no overage
1 GiB of durable storage and 3 sandboxes at 1 vCPU, 512 MiB and 8 GiB of disk

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not stated in the source card. `email` is the assumed value because every priced host in the set requires an account, and no signup was performed, so the kind is not established for this provider

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
confidence_note: the pricing page was read on 2026-10-22 and states the free pool in computer-hours with a hard cap and no overage. The pool is what makes the duty cycle computable: 5 vCPU-hours a month is about 10 minutes a day

evidence.proved: listed in the peli-cloud corpus card at commit f6a71ab0; the card is the source, not the vendor page

'every sandbox is a small computer, billed for the time it actually runs. plans bundle a monthly pool of compute' with a free pool of '5 vcpu-hours, 20 memory gib-hours, 20 disk gib-hours, 1 gib durable storage cap' described as 'hard cap. no overage. 3 sandboxes, each 1 vcpu, 512 mib, 8 gib disk', quoted
egress is open by default and no allowance or price is stated
evidence.quote: by default, sandboxes can reach the public internet.

evidence.proved: the cloud is reached through the SDK with an API key
evidence.quote: With an API key set, the same SDK runs sandboxes on [microsandbox cloud](https://docs.microsandbox.dev/cloud/overview.md) instead.

extras.keep_rate_basis: billed for uptime (no suspension feature published)

shape.note: the free shape: 1 vCPU, 512 MiB and 8 GiB of disk, three at a time

session_cap.note: billed for the time a sandbox actually runs; the monthly pool is the bound and the page states no reap

extras.price_note: a price without a shape and a horizon is not a price; both columns are kept because the two seed models disagree and neither is wrong
extras.free_tier_kind_basis: decided from the page read on 2026-10-22

ps.price: a 1 GiB durable-storage cap on the free pool
